name: Kiro
description: Kiro CLI (Amazon, was Amazon Q Developer CLI): chat with Kiro inside {appName}. Has a small free tier: sign in with an AWS Builder ID, Google or GitHub.

signIn.label: Sign in (free with Builder ID, Google or GitHub)…
signIn.tip: Kiro asks how to sign in (pick a free option or a Pro licence), then opens your browser. The app never sees your password.
signIn.intro: Pick how to sign in with the buttons below, then finish in your browser.

signIn.label: Sign in with a device code…
signIn.tip: Shows a code to type on a web page, for when the browser can't open here.
signIn.intro: Follow the steps shown here to sign in with a device code.

signOut.confirm: Sign Kiro CLI out on this computer? (It signs out the kiro-cli command everywhere, not only here.)
